page.layout: One column of numbered bibliographic entries, IV to XI, each set as a paragraph with its Roman numeral opening the entry, followed by a printer's ornament below the last entry. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. A red handwritten shelf mark sits lower right, outside the printed text.

main_text.l: IV. De triumphe Ecclesiæ ORIENTALIS atque OCCIDEN-
TALIS perpetua in dogmate de Purgatorio consensione, ad
ALEXANDRUM VII. Pont. Opt. Max. Addita sunt.
Eiusdem Epistola ad JOANNEM CHRISTIANUM de
BOINEBURG, De perpetua Ecclesiæ ORIENTALIS atque
OCCIDENTALIS tum in dogmate, tam in Ritibus
consensione. Ad BARTOLDUM NIHUSIUM Epistola secunda
De communione Græcorum sub unica specie; & De textu
Machabæorum De Sacrificio pro mortuis, & textum Græcum
dicere, quod exprimit textus Latinus. EUSTRATII Con-
stantinopolitani De Animabus separatis, IOANNIS VECCI
Patriarchæ Constantinopolitani ad Sugdæa THEODORUM
liber tertius, de causa schismatis, Græce, & Latine eo-
dem ALLATIO Interprete, 1655. in 8.
V. Carmina Græca, in CHRISTINAM Suecorum Reginam.
Ibidem in 4. 1656
VI. S. METHODII Episcopi, & Martyris CONVIVIVM
decem Virginum, siue, De Castitate, ad ALEXANDRUM
VII. Pont. Opt. Max. LEO ALLATIUS hactenus non
editum primus Græce vulgavit, Latine vertit, NOTAS,
& DIATRIBAM De Methodiorum scriptis. 1656. in 8.
VII. Vindiciæ Synodi EPHESINÆ, & S. CYRILLI De
Processione ex Patre & Filio Spiritus sancti. 1659. in 8.
VIII. Enchiridion De processione Spiritus sancti, Lingua Græ-
corum vernacula. 1658. in 12.
IX. De Symbolo S. ATHANASII lingua Græcorum ver-
nacula. Ibidem. in 12.
X. IOANNES HENRICUS HOTTINGERUS
Fraudis, & impostura manifestæ convictus a LEONE ALLATIO.
XI. LEONIS ALLATII De Octava Synodo PHOTIANA.
Adnexa est eiusdem IOANNIS HENRICI HOTTIN-
GERI Disputationis Apologeticæ De Ecclesia Orientalis, atque
Occidentalis tam in Dogmatibus quam in Ritibus diffensus,
& JUVENIS ULMENSIS Exercitationis Historico-Theologicæ
de Ecclesia Græcanica Indiernx, REFUTATIO.

page.notes: Entry IV: the Roman numeral at the start is uncertain (the top of the scan is worn), so it is read as IV. The word "Indiernx" in XI is not clear; the likely reading is "hodiernæ", which is not certain, so it is copied as the scan shows. "Vindiciæ" and "Ioannes" are read from a worn scan. The red handwritten shelf mark and the printer's ornament are not transcribed.
